description: Main React component for Student Information System web app, managing state, data fetching, UI rendering, and user interactions.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between light and dark UI themes.

methods.name: openAdd
methods.description: Opens the form to add a new student.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Opens the form to edit an existing student.

methods.name: onSubmitForm
methods.description: Handles submission of the student form for adding or updating students.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a student record after user confirmation.

methods.name: onChangePageSize
methods.description: Changes the number of students displayed per page.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Navigates to the next page of students.

methods.name: prevPage
methods.description: Navigates to the previous page of students.

methods.name: onSortChange
methods.description: Changes the sorting column and direction.
